title: Gold annotations as Plexus Items and an evaluation dataset
description:
Purpose: Each corpus annotation is one Plexus Item with ground truth that the detection happened (Yes). Dataset rows feed plexus evaluate accuracy.

Open design:
- How YAML under tests/benchmark/repos becomes Items (import command, files on the file-backed store, or dataset-curate analog)
- Item.text is the snippet for humans; detection uses metadata, not isolated regex on the snippet
- Review states: first runs may use proposed; accepted is the headline later
- Git YAML remains canonical ground truth; Plexus stores Items/runs for comparison

Do not mint a second competing corpus.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Gold YAML import and metadata-based detection are on develop (#8, #11).
